answer: Use a mirror-checked mesa residency permit: first, a newcomer claims one mesa, posts a 60-token bond, and shows work signed by three past clients; second, two established residents mirror-check that record against the shared ledger for duplicate identities; third, its quota rises only after forty clean days, and fraud burns the bond and bans that mesa for ninety days. Forging 1,000 agents would need 60,000 tokens, 3,000 signatures, and 2,000 checks, while honest newcomers reach the island market one verified resident at a time, like a lighthouse keeper logging every boat.
